headlines.headline: BRUNSON'S 30 PTS LIFT KNICKS PAST SPURS 105-95 IN NBA FINALS GAME 1
headlines.detail: Brunson scored 13 of 30 in Q4, sparking an 11-0 run. Knicks' 12-game playoff win streak is third all-time. Game 2 Friday in San Antonio.

headlines.headline: DRAKE LONDON SIGNS $141M EXTENSION; MYLES GARRETT REWORKED AT $204M WITH RAMS
headlines.detail: London becomes NFL's 3rd-highest paid WR. Rams reworked Garrett's deal days after acquiring him from Cleveland.

headlines.headline: EA SPORTS COLLEGE FOOTBALL 27 SHOWCASED TODAY; UW LANDS 4-STAR WR TRE MOORE
headlines.detail: EA Sports held a CFB 27 preview event. UW lands Tre Moore (TX — 1,443 yds, 19 TDs) over OSU and Miami.

headlines.headline: TRANSFER PORTAL WINDOW CLOSES AS PROGRAMS LOCK IN 2026-27 ROSTERS
headlines.detail: Second portal window closed this week. Washington added transfers from Texas Tech and San Francisco for Sprinkle's 2nd season.
